reference.source: F10A (2026-10-17): two roadside AA emplacements for A3's column (F3 section 4: 'two roadside AAA'). Not a field: no strip, never a recovery, home or landing target (noStrip). Positions invented: 150 m east of the road at 1.5 km and 3.5 km along it; local frame x east, z south (heading 0) about the point 2.5 km along the road. Scenery targets with no objective weight.
